description_en: Resets the password for a database account in an ApsaraDB for SelectDB instance
description_zh: 重置云数据库SelectDB版实例的账号密码
kebab_example: aliyun selectdb reset-account-password --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id selectdb-cn-7213cjv0000 --account-name admin --account-password a1b2c3d4@ --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetAccountPassword

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account. The password must meet the following requirements:

- The password must consist of at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
- The special characters are !@#$%^&\*()\_+-=.
- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的密码，取值说明：

- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符中的至少三种组成。

- !@#$%^&*()_+-=为特殊字符。

- 长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: account_password
